item.title: Summarise a Disagreement Over a Shared Venue
item.prompt_text: One group wants to store half-finished scenery overnight so volunteers can continue the next morning. A second group needs the floor clear for an early exercise class. There is a side room, but its capacity and exit clearance have not been checked. Write a neutral meeting summary that accurately represents both demands, distinguishes confirmed facts from assumptions, and proposes a limited test neither group has yet agreed to.
item.audience: two groups that use the same community venue
item.target_grammar: Attribution and conditionals. Use precise modality for a proposal that is pending agreement.
item.target_structure: Record the separate needs, list only verified facts, define test conditions, and explain how to review the result.

checklist.point: Represent the two reasons without favouring one group.
Separate the known side room from unverified capacity or clearance.
Propose a limited test with clear conditions.
Show how the result and agreement would be recorded.
